changes: documented CLI/--out examples moved from repo-root-relative bundle.json to results/frontier/frontier-query-retrieval/scratch/ (prevention for the exit-code-4 scope failures of runs 38192249068 and 38193491547)
run_live_evidence.py: run id comes only from LEX_FRONTIER_RUN_ID (no previous-run default) and A0_fresh_live_network rejects zero-network 'live' evidence unless LEX_ALLOW_CACHE_REPLAY=1
verify_scope_safe.sh: repository root is passed explicitly instead of guessed (the old parent-walk matched results/frontier/frontier-query-retrieval and crashed the contract-import check)
revisions.schema_impact: none; candidate/product schemas, public API and rates are unchanged

produced_by.scope: reusable retrieval/cache adapter, fixtures and normalized bundle contract only; no app shell, no UI, no answer generation

consumer.owns: end-to-end integration, answer generation, visual map, evaluation owns benchmarks

adapter.name: ocl_adapter
adapter.note: stdlib only (urllib/hashlib/json/dataclasses); the parent directory name contains a hyphen so the importable unit is the child package 'ocl_adapter'
adapter.cap_enforcement: max_candidates is a true hard cap: page loops stop fetching at the cap, and any final-page overshoot (up to page_size records) is trimmed deterministically to the highest-ranked candidates after dedupe. provenance.targets records pre_trim_candidates and trimmed_to_max_candidates so consumers can audit the trim.

steps: from ocl_adapter import AdapterConfig, build_candidate_bundle, to_product_bundle, validate_candidate_bundle
product_bundle = to_product_bundle(bundle)  # keys match product/query/bundle.py REQUIRED_TOP
run with cwd=<repo_root>/frontier/frontier-query-retrieval (or PYTHONPATH set to that dir)
exit codes: 0 ok, 2 usage/config error, 3 no candidates, 4 validation errors
output-path rule: --out/--product-bundle must stay inside your lane namespace or a system temp dir; never write bundle*.json at the repository root (see scope_safety)
deterministic at candidate-content level across runs and processes (verified by tests/frontier/frontier-query-retrieval/test_ocl_adapter_scope_safety.py and verify_determinism.py)

scope_safety.why: The Frontier workflow enforces team write scope on the working tree; one stray file outside frontier/<team>/, tests/frontier/<team>/, results/frontier/<team>/, reports/frontier/<team>/, state/frontier/<team>.json fails the whole run with exit code 4. Runs 38192249068 (root-level bundle*.json from a relative --out) and 38193491547 (product/** copy) both died this way.
scope_safety.documented_command_rule: every CLI example in this contract writes --out/--product-bundle under results/frontier/frontier-query-retrieval/scratch/ or a system temp dir; this is pinned by test_documented_commands_never_write_repo_root
scope_safety.supported_harness: frontier/frontier-query-retrieval/verify_scope_safe.sh smoke-tests the adapter from any working directory and writes only into results/frontier/frontier-query-retrieval/verification/<stamp>/
scope_safety.scratch_dir: results/frontier/frontier-query-retrieval/scratch/ (create on demand; disposable by-products only, never claim-bearing evidence)
scope_safety.pycache: set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 or use python3 -B when smoke-testing inside the checkout

evidence_freshness.rule: LIVE_*.json is claim-bearing. run_live_evidence.py requires LEX_FRONTIER_RUN_ID (no default from a previous run) and fails check A0_fresh_live_network when a scenario performs zero network calls, unless LEX_ALLOW_CACHE_REPLAY=1 is set explicitly (the evidence is then flagged cache_replayed=true).
evidence_freshness.provenance: results/frontier/frontier-query-retrieval/archive/ preserves every historical LIVE_* generation; never overwrite one in place
evidence_freshness.determinism: given identical HTTP responses the adapter is deterministic (warm-cache and cross-process fixture probes agree); a different candidate set under a 'live' label therefore indicates a stale cache replay, which A0_fresh_live_network now rejects

public_api.purpose: all knobs (mode, target, max_candidates, page_size, max_pages_per_variant, lang_max_pages, max_requests, max_rps<=5.0, stages, citation_*, leading_*, hydrate_needs_detail, cache_dir, base_url)

public_api.signature: build_candidate_bundle(query, *, config=None, transport=None, client=None, cache=None, hydrate_ids=None, hydrate_top=0, include_structure=True, stages=None, clock=time.time) -> dict
public_api.purpose: full retrieval run -> normalized candidate bundle
candidate bundle -> product query_result_bundle (answer/clusters/relations pending upstream)
candidate bundle schema validation (empty list = valid)
counts, channels, languages, dedupe, degraded, n_failures, request_summary
canonical identity merge; output order independent of input order
original + lexicon expansion + de/fr/it server-side language filters; no machine translation
content-addressed envelope cache (sha256 of path+canonical params), TTL enforced by transport
typed endpoint surface over a Transport

public_api.signature: HttpTransport / CachedTransport / FixtureTransport / ScriptedTransport (.get(path, params) -> RawResponse)
public_api.purpose: network, cache policy, deterministic replay, failure injection for tests
soft pace <=5 req/s and hard request budget

public_api.signature: OCLError > OCLTransportError, OCLHTTPError, OCLDecodeError, OCLCacheMiss, OCLBudgetExceeded, OCLValidationError
public_api.purpose: typed failures; pipeline degrades instead of crashing

product_bundle.note: to_product_bundle() fills placeholders; product fills answer/clusters/relations/x/y/counter_status upstream of the adapter

modes.live: cache hit short-circuits; miss fetches HTTPS and writes the envelope cache
modes.offline: cache only; a miss degrades (status=0, provenance.degraded=true) instead of raising
modes.refresh: always fetches and rewrites the cache

fixtures.fixture_replay_determinism: fixture replay is deterministic at the candidate-content level: identical decision_id sequence, ordering, channels, counts and provenance strings across re-runs. Only run-metadata fields (generated_at, provenance.latency_seconds) vary between replays, as expected for a run record.

rate_limits.enforcement: RateLimiter inside HttpTransport; AdapterConfig rejects max_rps outside (0, 5.0]

tests.framework: stdlib unittest (no third-party test runner required)

reuse.lexicon: copied_from:accepted/product/product/query/retrieval.py#EXPANSION (closed tables only; every added term labelled accepted_lexicon)
reuse.patterns: cache/navigation patterns inspected under /tmp/lex_accepted/core/product (product/query/corpus.py cached_live_search, product/app/navigation.py key cache); adapter supersedes the unversioned opencaselaw.org/api/search endpoint with the documented mcp.opencaselaw.ch/api surface + content-addressed envelope cache

handoff.product_action: import ocl_adapter (sys.path or vendored copy), call build_candidate_bundle + to_product_bundle, then fill answer/clusters/relations; do not re-implement dedupe, caching or provenance
handoff.evaluation_action: use fixtures/ + LIVE_EVIDENCE.json as frozen retrieval inputs; do not re-record fixtures while benchmarks are frozen
handoff.ownership: changes to the adapter belong to frontier-query-retrieval under the same charter; product may copy but should record divergence in its own state

compatibility.schema_freeze: candidate-1.0 / 1.0-candidate fields above are the frozen seam; additive fields are allowed, removals require a contract_version bump
